Alex (eng-release): Heads-up — we've got a production regression from the new int8 quantization kernel hitting a subset of models (mistral-large variants). Some prompts produce NaN tokens and truncated outputs after ~80 tokens. Recommend an immediate revert of the quant-kernel rollout.
Priya (oncall): Ack. Do we have a clear repro and a canary impact window?
Sam (eng-ml): Repro is solid on 2024-07-11 prod snapshot. Minimal QPS but high severity for users relying on long generations. Steps to repro attached in convo.
Mateo (sre): If we revert, what's the rollback command? We need the exact deploy id and pin.
Alex (eng-release): Deploy id: `deploy/infra/quant-kernel@b3f9c2`. Revert candidate: `release/quant-kernel-revert@9a8d7f`. Proposed rollout: 5% canary -> 25% in 10m -> 100% in 30m, with auto-rollback on error rate > 1% or latency spike > 30%.
Alex (eng-release): Command to trigger:```/deploybot promote --from release/quant-kernel-revert@9a8d7f --to prod --policy canary=5,25,100 --monitors error_rate,latency```
deploy-bot: Deploy request received: promoting release/quant-kernel-revert@9a8d7f to prod. Waiting approvals from EngRelease, SRE, and Product. CI checks: warmup-tests passed, smoke-tests failed (see logs).
Jane (prod): We need a short release note and customer comms. ETA to full rollback?
Alex (eng-release): ETA to full 100% if no regressions: ~35 minutes from approval. Release note draft: "Reverted latest int8 quantization kernel due to generation corruption in long sequences for select models. No model weights changed; serving kernel rolled back to previous stable path."
Mateo (sre): I need 2 approvals from SRE leads or oncall. @ops-oncall can you +1? Also, please pin the failing change in the rollout tracker.
ops-oncall: +1 from ops-oncall. I confirm healthchecks and can hold the gateway if we need to stop traffic.
Priya (oncall): +1 from oncall. I'll watch the canary and escalate on anomalies.
Sam (eng-ml): Verified that reverting removes NaNs on the repro prompts. Good to go.
Jane (prod): +1 from Product, please include the release note in the public changelog and notify customers on the known issue page.
Alex (eng-release): All approvals collected. Kicking deploy now.
deploy-bot: Starting canary promotion: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Monitor URL: https://console.redwood/internal/deploys/release/9a8d7f
deploy-bot: Canary 5% complete. No increase in error_rate. Latency steady. Proceeding to 25%.
deploy-bot: Canary 25% complete. Minor spike in CPU but within thresholds. Proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: release/quant-kernel-revert@9a8d7f is now live in prod.
Alex (eng-release): Closing the loop — rollback succeeded, repro confirmed fixed. I'll update the changelog and file a follow-up postmortem to dig into how the int8 kernel slipped through perf tests.
Mateo (sre): I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and escalate if anything odd.
Jane (prod): Thanks team. Please add a short note in the customer incident tracker. :thumbsup:
